notes:
Taps at the bottom of the screen, and ghosting on the second tablet.

**Taps on the lower part of a tab, or on the page slider, were being taken by the tablet itself.** That bar sits right along the bottom edge of the screen, which is where Android and Onyx both listen for their own edge gestures — so a touch starting there never reached Obbligato at all. The app now claims that strip back, so taps land where you put them. This is the same fix already used for the page-turn zones down the left and right sides.

**Tabs are bigger.** Their touch area was smaller than the minimum recommended for a fingertip, which made a near-miss into a miss.

**The second tablet's logo screen no longer ghosts.** Going back to the library left a dense page of music faintly burnt into an almost blank screen. It now clears properly once the logo is up.

Your library, annotations and licence are not affected.
